title: Intelligent Soil Analyzer and Crop Fertilizers Advisory System

account: Mbeya University of Science and Technology is developing a system that analyzes soil with sensors and predicts suitable crops and fertilizer. The team says that a random forest classifier is going to be the main machine-learning algorithm. The intended benefits are higher yields and less fertilizer waste. No source reports that any farmer used the system.

data.answer:
MUST is developing sensor-based soil analysis and a random-forest advisory model. Yield improvements and lower fertilizer waste remain intended.

The random-forest model and fertilizer-advice functions are described as development objectives. No comparative crop yield, farmer income, fertilizer use, or soil-health result is supplied. Accurate sensor readings alone would not verify useful fertilizer recommendations.

The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.
